name: yas-downloader
description: Next-generation high-speed download manager for Windows
author: YAS Downloader

scripts.build:electron: esbuild electron/main.ts --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs --platform=node --format=cjs --bundle --external:electron && esbuild electron/preload.ts --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs --platform=node --format=cjs --bundle --external:electron && esbuild electron/downloadDialogPreload.ts --outfile=dist-electron/downloadDialogPreload.cjs --platform=node --format=cjs --bundle --external:electron && esbuild electron/nm-host.ts --outfile=dist-electron/nm-host.cjs --platform=node --format=cjs --bundle --external:electron && pkg dist-electron/nm-host.cjs -t node18-win-x64 -o dist-electron/yas-nm-host.exe
scripts.build:all: npm run setup:bin && npm run build && npm run build:electron
scripts.pack: npm run setup:bin && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist: npm run setup:bin && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win: npm run setup:bin && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
